title: Feeding Our Future verdicts: Full list of each charge and verdict
supports: Contemporaneous verdict reporting states that Said Shafii Farah was found not guilty on all nine counts against him: Count 1 wire-fraud conspiracy; Count 12 wire fraud; Count 13 conspiracy to commit federal-programs bribery; Counts 16, 18, and 19 federal-programs bribery; Count 20 conspiracy to commit money laundering; and Counts 21 and 40 money laundering.

The same report states that Abdiwahab Maalim Aftin was found not guilty on all three counts against him: Count 1 wire-fraud conspiracy, Count 20 conspiracy to commit money laundering, and Count 27 money laundering.
The report provides count-by-count guilty/not-guilty outcomes for all seven trial defendants.
does_not_support: Primary judicial proof of the verdicts; verdict forms, a minute entry, or another court record remain the preferred source.
A scheme-wide conviction count after June 7, 2024.
notes: The nine-count denominator for Said Farah and three-count denominator for Aftin align with the count assignments in the captured ECF 57 superseding indictment. Minnesota Reformer contemporaneously reported the same full-acquittal outcome but later described Said Farah as acquitted of 'all eight charges'; that denominator is inconsistent with both FOX 9's count matrix and the primary indictment count assignments.
